description: Measure a rigged .glb: its bones (names, parents, positions), meshes, height, the animations with problems, worst first, each with the moment it's worst at to render (ground: % of height its lowest point goes below the rest floor or stays above it, and which bone; stretching: % of skin torn at worst; humans: frames with a forearm or hand through the body, and the deepest) and the animation controls adjust_animation takes. Flying, swimming and other animations that leave the floor on purpose are marked in_the_air and not judged against it. Runs on this computer, free: about a second, a few for a human's 196 animations.

animations.description: only these animations, each listed whether it has a problem or not

file.description: a rigged .glb (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory): one rig_model wrote, or any model on afk.ai's skeletons

limit.description: at most this many animations with problems, worst first (default 40; the rest are named)

type.description: the body type, when it can't be told from the file (afk.ai's files say)

name: inspect_rig
